reports.title: Sentencing remarks as Russell Brand is jailed for over 10 years
reports.description:
WARNING: This video contains graphic and distressing content.

A judge has slammed Russell Brand’s “staggering arrogance” as he sentenced him to 10-and-a-half years in prison for rape and three counts of sexual assault. Sentencing remarks by Mr Justice Bennathan.

For more, visit https://www.independent.ie/.

#RussellBrand #News #UK

reports.title: VIDEO: Residents protest Scientology-linked drug rehab centre due to open beside creche
reports.description: A protest has been held in opposition to a drug rehab centre linked to Scientology which could soon be situated beside a creche and montessori.
